commercial_identity.successor_identity_rule: Customer-facing successor artifacts use only ARE and Keld identities; legacy repository-wrapper names, paths, and product identifiers must not appear.

contacts.activation_condition: The address must pass delivery, acknowledgement, escalation, and closure tests before it is presented as an active security commitment.

accountable_owners.reliability_slo_disposition: NOT_APPLICABLE while Keld does not operate ARE as a service

use_and_data_scope.intended_use: Customer-operated software-development assistance on repositories the customer is authorized to access.
use_and_data_scope.human_oversight: One human operator approves consequential changes.
use_and_data_scope.data_control: The customer controls repository data, prompts, credentials, retained state, and model-provider selection.
use_and_data_scope.vendor_telemetry: none in the first customer release
use_and_data_scope.vendor_operated_processing: none in the first customer release
use_and_data_scope.framework_posture: No voluntary certification or conformity claim is selected for the first customer release; applicable mandatory law and contracts remain subject to qualified review.

license_direction.trademark_posture: Keld names and marks are excluded from the software license except for truthful identification and required attribution.
license_direction.patent_posture: The exact license should grant patent rights needed to use the licensed software and terminate that patent grant for a party that initiates patent litigation alleging the software infringes.

commercial_operations_direction.delivery: paid download of the complete self-contained ARE successor source closure
commercial_operations_direction.service_posture: customer-operated software; Keld does not operate the first release as a hosted service
commercial_operations_direction.taxes: Collect and remit taxes where applicable after qualified jurisdiction and merchant review.
commercial_operations_direction.refunds: Disclose digital delivery before purchase and honor mandatory refund and consumer rights in each customer market.
commercial_operations_direction.privacy: Publish terms consistent with customer-controlled local operation and disclose every external model-provider data flow.
commercial_operations_direction.support: Paid support is a separate service and does not change the redistributed-copy resale rule.

remaining_evidence_gates: review and clear the Candidate 018 source-rights and notice inventory
obtain qualified review for United States, European Union, and Brazil consumer, tax, privacy, refund, trademark, patent, and license obligations
obtain qualified approval of the exact LICENSE, notices, customer summary, and commercial terms
verify the security and support contact workflow
freeze and verify the standalone ARE/Keld 0.10.0-rc.1 successor
claim_limit: This record captures product-owner decisions. It is not legal advice, qualified legal approval, rights clearance, contact verification, sale authorization, or a license grant.
